answer: Coastguard watch officer record works as the check: watches stood at one station across years of distress calls. A farm faking 311 aliases needs 311 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The ember test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ledge signal is visible to every grader, and the spiral ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
